## WF-07 · Browser Call Simulator

Always shows 'SIMULATED — BROWSER DEMO, NOT A PHONE CALL' in the page itself (pages/simulator.html). This workflow only serves the page and the two JSON APIs it calls.

**Credentials needed:** Postgres nodes use your Supabase credential; 'Agent Reply' uses Predefined Credential Type = OpenAi.

**REPLACE after import:**
- 'Read Simulator Page' file path
- 'Classify Via WF-03' workflowId -> WF-03's imported id

The call_attempts row itself is created by WF-02 (mode=simulated) BEFORE the simulator page opens; this workflow only reads/updates that existing row via the ?attempt= id passed in the simulator URL.

nodes.name: Read Simulator Page
nodes.notes: REPLACE fileSelector with the absolute path to pages/simulator.html on your laptop.

parameters.query:
SELECT ca.id AS call_attempt_id, l.id AS lead_id, l.name AS lead_name,
       (SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM (SELECT name, configurations, price_range, amenities, faqs FROM properties LIMIT 1) p) AS property,
       (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = 'openai_model') AS openai_model
FROM call_attempts ca JOIN leads l ON l.id = ca.lead_id
WHERE ca.id = $1;

nodes.name: Agent Reply
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL REQUIRED (OpenAI). Uses the same agent prompt as the Bolna voice agent (plan §8.1), so the simulator behaves identically for demo purposes.

parameters.query: UPDATE call_attempts SET transcript = $2, ended_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING lead_id;

nodes.name: Save Transcript Snapshot
nodes.notes: CREDENTIAL REQUIRED. Saves the raw transcript immediately so it isn't lost even if classification below fails validation.

nodes.name: Classify Via WF-03
nodes.notes: REPLACE workflowId with WF-03's id after import. Sends the simulated transcript down the exact same classification + validation + action path as a real Bolna call.
